testcase.name: a press samples the scene from the touch until its glass has gone
without refraction a tap and a drag move a plain indicator
a slow release lands on the nearest tab
a tap glides the lens to the tab without pressing it, then stops drawing
a cancelled drag returns to the selected tab
a release settles on the tab the velocity points to, carrying the velocity
a press swells the lens and it trails the finger across the bar
the lens stretches along its travel and never drops below its resting size
travel rises with the lens's speed
a tap's motion lifts the lens into glass, which calms as the lens settles
a lens that stops refracting under the finger lets its swell recede
the finger cannot drag the lens past either end
a tap samples the scene while it travels and stops before the lens has settled
